summary: The implementation successfully addresses all core requirements for the customer review system. All five requirements (REQ-35 through REQ-39) have corresponding implementations in the diff. The backend includes review storage functions, the frontend contains the ReviewsSection component with submission form and display logic, and React Query hooks handle data fetching and mutations. However, one acceptance criterion is not fully verifiable from the truncated diff: persistence across canister upgrades (REQ-37) cannot be confirmed without seeing stable variable declarations or upgrade hooks.

missing_requirements.reason: The backend/main.mo diff shows customerReviews stored in a Map, but no stable variable declarations or system upgrade/preupgrade hooks are visible in the provided diff. Without explicit stable storage or upgrade logic, reviews may not persist across canister upgrades.

hallucinated_features.description: Additional backend query functions not requested: getCustomerReview(id) and getReviewsByService(serviceType)
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest only specified submitReview and getAllReviews functions. The implementation added getCustomerReview for individual review retrieval by ID and getReviewsByService for filtering reviews by service type, which were not in the requirements or acceptance criteria.

The ReviewsSection.tsx generates review IDs on the frontend using timestamp and random string. REQ-37 explicitly specified auto-incrementing ID in the backend, suggesting server-side ID generation was expected.

hallucinated_features.description: Rating validation in backend with range check and error trapping
hallucinated_features.reason: The backend includes validation logic that traps if rating is not between 1-5. While sensible, this specific validation behavior was not mentioned in the requirements or acceptance criteria.
